
---
title: "Boxplots marginal gene exp for pancreas"
output: html_document
date: "2025-05-22"
---



```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0) Load libraries & set seed
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(KEGGREST)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
set.seed(1234)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1) Load & preprocess your pancreas data
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pancreas_data      <- readRDS("data/pancreas_human.rds")
metadata           <- pancreas_data@meta.data
pancreas_cells_ctrl<- metadata %>%
  filter(cell_type == "type B pancreatic cell",
         disease_state == "Control")

count_matrix <- pancreas_data@assays[["RNA"]]@counts
count_matrix <- count_matrix[, rownames(pancreas_cells_ctrl)]

seurat_obj      <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts      = count_matrix,
  min.cells   = 3,
  min.features= 10
)
seurat_obj      <- SCTransform(seurat_obj, vst.flavor="v2", verbose=FALSE)
filtered_counts <- seurat_obj@assays[["SCT"]]@counts
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2) Define active vs. inactive pathway KEGG IDs
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
active <- c(
  "AMPK signaling pathway"                 = "hsa04152",
  "Insulin signaling pathway"              = "hsa04910",
  "FoxO signaling pathway"                 = "hsa04068"
)

inactive <- c(
  "Apoptosis"                              = "hsa04210",
  "Bacterial invasion of epithelial cells" = "hsa05100",
  "Pathogenic E. coli infection"           = "hsa05130"
)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3) Helper: fetch Entrez → Ensembl (with KEGGREST fallback)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_ensembl <- function(kegg_id) {
  entry <- paste0("path:", kegg_id)
  info  <- keggGet(entry)[[1]]
  if (!is.null(info$GENE)) {
    entrez <- info$GENE[seq(1, length(info$GENE), by = 2)] %>%
      sub("^hsa:", "", .)
  } else {
    links  <- keggLink("hsa", entry)
    entrez <- sub("^hsa:", "", as.vector(links))
  }
  suppressMessages(
    mapIds(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys      = entrez,
      column    = "ENSEMBL",
      keytype   = "ENTREZID",
      multiVals = "first"
    )
  ) %>% 
    na.omit() %>% 
    unname()
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4) Build per-pathway gene lists
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pathways   <- c(active, inactive)
genes_list <- map(pathways, get_ensembl)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5) Compute per-gene mean SCT expression & cap at 10
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gene_means <- rowMeans(filtered_counts)
gene_means <- pmin(gene_means, 5)   # cap at 5

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6) Assemble a data.frame: one row per gene×pathway
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_all <- imap_dfr(genes_list, function(genes, pw) {
  tibble(
    pathway    = pw,
    gene       = genes,
    expression = gene_means[genes],
    status     = if_else(pw %in% names(active),
                         "Active", "Inactive")
  )
})

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7) Plot: boxplots per pathway, colored by active/inactive
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_box <- ggplot(df_all,
                aes(x = factor(pathway, levels = names(pathways)),
                    y = expression,
                    fill = status)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Active"   = "#e14b31",
                               "Inactive" = "#009ADE")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 5.01),
    breaks = seq(0, 5, by = 1),
    labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", expression("\u2265 "*5))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Mean SCT Expression",
    fill  = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5)
  )

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 8) Save main plot WITHOUT legend
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(cowplot)   # <-- this defines get_legend()

p_main <- p_box + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(
  filename = "figures/fig2b_pancreas_main_boxplot.jpg",
  plot     = p_main,
  width    = 16,
  height   = 6,
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 600
)

plot(p_main)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 9) Extract & save horizontal (bottom) legend as its own figure
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(cowplot)

# extract your legend grob
legend_horiz <- get_legend(
  p_box +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.key.size  = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 16)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(
      keywidth     = unit(5, "lines"),
      keyheight    = unit(4, "lines"),
      override.aes = list(colour = "black", size = 2)
    ))
)

# save it directly
cowplot::save_plot(
  "figures/fig2b_pancreas_legend_horizontal.jpg",
  legend_horiz,
  base_width  = 8,
  base_height = 2,
  dpi         = 600
)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 10) Extract & save vertical (stacked) legend as its own figure
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_vert <- get_legend(
  p_box +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.key.size  = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 16)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(
      ncol         = 1,
      keywidth     = unit(5, "lines"),
      keyheight    = unit(4, "lines"),
      override.aes = list(colour = "black", size = 2)
    ))
)

cowplot::save_plot(
  "figures/fig2b_pancreas_legend_vertical.jpg",
  legend_vert,
  base_width  = 3,
  base_height = 4,
  dpi         = 600
)

```
